tbesh_html:
1) to grow, become great or important, promote, make powerful, praise, magnify, do great things
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to grow up
1a2) to become great
1a3) to be magnified
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to cause to grow
1b2) to make great, powerful
1b3) to magnify
1c) (Pual) to be brought up
1d) (Hiphil)
1d1) to make great
1d2) to magnify
1d3) to do great things
1e) (Hithpael) to magnify oneself

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to twist (compare H1434 (גְּדִל)), i.e.
strongs_1890.kjv_def: advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to... estate, [phrase] things), grow(up), increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower.

occurrences.bsb: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
occurrences.kjv: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

occurrences.bsb: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”
occurrences.kjv: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.

occurrences.bsb: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.
occurrences.kjv: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

occurrences.bsb: So the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day Isaac was weaned.
occurrences.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

occurrences.bsb: And God was with the boy, and he grew up and settled in the wilderness and became a great archer.
occurrences.kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

occurrences.bsb: “The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

occurrences.bsb: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
occurrences.kjv: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

occurrences.bsb: and he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.
occurrences.kjv: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

occurrences.bsb: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

occurrences.bsb: she removed her widow’s garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah. For she saw that although Shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.
occurrences.kjv: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

occurrences.bsb: You shall be in charge of my house, and all my people are to obey your commands. Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

occurrences.bsb: But his father refused. “I know, my son, I know!” he said. “He too shall become a people, and he too shall be great; nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations.”
occurrences.kjv: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

occurrences.bsb: When the child had grown older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.”
occurrences.kjv: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

occurrences.bsb: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his own people and observed their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

occurrences.bsb: For the entire period of his vow of separation, no razor shall touch his head. He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete; he must let the hair of his head grow long.
occurrences.kjv: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

occurrences.bsb: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:
occurrences.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

occurrences.bsb: Now the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

occurrences.bsb: On that day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they revered him all the days of his life, just as they had revered Moses.
occurrences.kjv: On that day the Lord magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

occurrences.bsb: And Gilead’s wife bore him sons who grew up, drove Jephthah out, and said to him, “You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house, because you are the son of another woman.”
occurrences.kjv: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

occurrences.bsb: So the woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The boy grew, and the LORD blessed him.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the Lord blessed him.

occurrences.bsb: would you wait for them to grow up? Would you refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, it is much more bitter for me than for you, because the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.”
occurrences.kjv: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the Lord is gone out against me.

occurrences.bsb: So the LORD attended to Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and He let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
occurrences.kjv: And Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

occurrences.bsb: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.
occurrences.kjv: Only fear the Lord, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

occurrences.bsb: When the young man had gone, David got up from the south side of the stone, fell facedown, and bowed three times. Then he and Jonathan kissed each other and wept together—though David wept more.
occurrences.kjv: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

occurrences.bsb: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the LORD value my life and rescue me from all trouble.”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the Lord, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

occurrences.bsb: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD God of Hosts was with him.
occurrences.kjv: And David went on, and grew great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.

occurrences.bsb: How great You are, O Lord GOD! For there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore thou art great, O Lord God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

occurrences.bsb: so that Your name will be magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel.’ And the house of Your servant David will be established before You.
occurrences.kjv: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

occurrences.bsb: but the poor man had nothing except one small ewe lamb that he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food and drank from his cup; it slept in his arms and was like a daughter to him.
occurrences.kjv: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

occurrences.bsb: Just as the LORD was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon and make his throne even greater than that of my lord King David.”
occurrences.kjv: As the Lord hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

occurrences.bsb: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king has bowed in worship on his bed,
occurrences.kjv: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

occurrences.bsb: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
occurrences.kjv: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

occurrences.bsb: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
occurrences.kjv: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

occurrences.bsb: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you must make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
occurrences.kjv: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

occurrences.bsb: And the child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the harvesters.
occurrences.kjv: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter and said: “If you are on my side, and if you will obey me, then bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” Now the sons of the king, seventy in all, were being brought up by the leading men of the city.
occurrences.kjv: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

occurrences.bsb: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him.
occurrences.kjv: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.

occurrences.bsb: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
occurrences.kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

occurrences.bsb: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
occurrences.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

occurrences.bsb: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
occurrences.kjv: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

occurrences.bsb: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as had not been bestowed on any king in Israel before him.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Now Solomon son of David established himself securely over his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him and highly exalted him.
occurrences.kjv: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

occurrences.bsb: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
occurrences.kjv: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

occurrences.bsb: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
occurrences.kjv: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

occurrences.bsb: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you must make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
occurrences.kjv: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

occurrences.bsb: and said: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
occurrences.kjv: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

occurrences.bsb: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him to a position above all the princes who were with him.
occurrences.kjv: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

occurrences.bsb: Haman recounted to them his glorious wealth, his many sons, and all the ways the king had honored and promoted him over the other officials and servants.
occurrences.kjv: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

occurrences.bsb: For Mordecai exercised great power in the palace, and his fame spread throughout the provinces as he became more and more powerful.
occurrences.kjv: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

occurrences.bsb: And all of Mordecai’s powerful and magnificent accomplishments, together with the full account of the greatness to which the king had raised him, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Media and Persia?
occurrences.kjv: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

occurrences.bsb: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights, but no one spoke a word to him because they saw how intense his suffering was.
occurrences.kjv: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

occurrences.bsb: What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
occurrences.kjv: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

occurrences.bsb: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,
occurrences.kjv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

occurrences.bsb: though from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow—
occurrences.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)

occurrences.bsb: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
occurrences.kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

occurrences.bsb: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
occurrences.kjv: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

occurrences.bsb: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

occurrences.bsb: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

occurrences.bsb: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me—those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
occurrences.kjv: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

occurrences.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
occurrences.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

occurrences.bsb: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

occurrences.bsb: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
occurrences.kjv: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

occurrences.bsb: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
occurrences.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

occurrences.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
occurrences.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

occurrences.bsb: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
occurrences.kjv: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

occurrences.bsb: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
occurrences.kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

occurrences.bsb: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
occurrences.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

occurrences.bsb: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

occurrences.bsb: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
occurrences.kjv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

occurrences.bsb: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
occurrences.kjv: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

occurrences.bsb: I said to myself, “Behold, I have grown and increased in wisdom beyond all those before me who were over Jerusalem, and my mind has observed a wealth of wisdom and knowledge.”
occurrences.kjv: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

occurrences.bsb: I expanded my pursuits. I built houses and planted vineyards for myself.
occurrences.kjv: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

occurrences.bsb: So I became great and surpassed all in Jerusalem who had preceded me; and my wisdom remained with me.
occurrences.kjv: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

occurrences.bsb: Listen, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for the LORD has spoken: “I have raised children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against Me.
occurrences.kjv: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the Lord hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

occurrences.bsb: You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

occurrences.bsb: Does an axe raise itself above the one who swings it? Does a saw boast over him who saws with it? It would be like a rod waving the one who lifts it, or a staff lifting him who is not wood!
occurrences.kjv: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.

occurrences.bsb: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”
occurrences.kjv: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

occurrences.bsb: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom.
occurrences.kjv: This also cometh forth from the Lord of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.

occurrences.bsb: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.

occurrences.bsb: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak. He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel, and the rain makes it grow.
occurrences.kjv: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

occurrences.bsb: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has begotten these for me? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. So who has reared them? Look, I was left all alone, so where did they come from?’”
occurrences.kjv: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?

occurrences.bsb: Among all the sons she bore, there is no one to guide her; among all the sons she brought up, there is no one to take her hand.
occurrences.kjv: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.

occurrences.bsb: Like cages full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit. Therefore they have become powerful and rich.
occurrences.kjv: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

occurrences.bsb: “Make him drunk, because he has magnified himself against the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his own vomit, and he will also become a laughingstock.
occurrences.kjv: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

occurrences.bsb: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
occurrences.kjv: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Lord, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.

occurrences.bsb: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
occurrences.kjv: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

occurrences.bsb: I made you thrive like a plant of the field. You grew up and matured and became very beautiful. Your breasts were formed and your hair grew, but you were naked and bare.
occurrences.kjv: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.

occurrences.bsb: Yes, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the kindling high.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

occurrences.bsb: The waters made it grow; the deep springs made it tall, directing their streams all around its base and sending their channels to all the trees of the field.
occurrences.kjv: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

occurrences.bsb: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!
occurrences.kjv: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.

occurrences.bsb: I will magnify and sanctify Myself, and I will reveal Myself in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The king assigned them daily provisions of the royal food and wine. They were to be trained for three years, after which they were to enter the king’s service.
occurrences.kjv: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

occurrences.bsb: I saw the ram charging toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against him, and there was no deliverance from his power. He did as he pleased and became great.
occurrences.kjv: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

occurrences.bsb: Thus the goat became very great, but at the height of his power, his large horn was broken off, and four prominent horns came up in its place, pointing toward the four winds of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: From one of these horns a little horn emerged and grew extensively toward the south and the east and toward the Beautiful Land.
occurrences.kjv: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.

occurrences.bsb: It grew as high as the host of heaven, and it cast down some of the host and some of the stars to the earth and trampled them.
occurrences.kjv: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

occurrences.bsb: It magnified itself, even to the Prince of the host; it removed His daily sacrifice and overthrew the place of His sanctuary.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

occurrences.bsb: Through his craft and by his hand, he will cause deceit to prosper, and in his own mind he will make himself great. In a time of peace he will destroy many, and he will even stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be broken off, but not by human hands.
occurrences.kjv: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

occurrences.bsb: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.
occurrences.kjv: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

occurrences.bsb: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.
occurrences.kjv: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

occurrences.bsb: Even if they raise their children, I will bereave them of each one. Yes, woe be to them when I turn away from them!
occurrences.kjv: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

occurrences.bsb: The northern army I will drive away from you, banishing it to a barren and desolate land, its front ranks into the Eastern Sea, and its rear guard into the Western Sea. And its stench will rise; its foul odor will ascend. For He has done great things.
occurrences.kjv: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

occurrences.bsb: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
occurrences.kjv: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do great things.

occurrences.bsb: asking, “When will the New Moon be over, that we may sell grain? When will the Sabbath end, that we may market wheat? Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

occurrences.bsb: But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast proudly in the day of their distress.
occurrences.kjv: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

occurrences.bsb: But the LORD said, “You cared about the plant, which you neither tended nor made grow. It sprang up in a night and perished in a night.
occurrences.kjv: Then said the Lord, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

occurrences.bsb: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
occurrences.kjv: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

occurrences.bsb: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.
occurrences.kjv: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.

occurrences.bsb: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.

occurrences.bsb: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
occurrences.kjv: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

occurrences.bsb: You will see this with your own eyes, and you yourselves will say, ‘The LORD is great—even beyond the borders of Israel.’”
occurrences.kjv: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.
